en.headline: Heritage Museum opens Leslie Cheung 70th-birthday exhibition today
en.dek: More than 300 artefacts, including rarely seen stage costumes and a recreated room from the late star’s home, go on free display in Sha Tin until May 2027.
body: The Hong Kong Heritage Museum opens a major memorial exhibition on Wednesday marking what would have been Leslie Cheung Kwok-wing’s 70th birthday, presenting more than 300 items drawn from private and institutional collections.

Titled “Miss You Much. Leslie 70th Birthday. Exhibition” and organised by the Leisure and Cultural Services Department, the show runs from 9 September 2026 to 10 May 2027 at the museum in Sha Tin. Admission is free. Highlights include 11 stage costumes, among them the cloak worn for “For Your Heart Only” at the 1989 Final Encounter of the Legend concert and the gold jacket with purple-striped trousers from Live in Concert 97.

For the first time the museum has recreated part of the interior of Cheung’s former residence in collaboration with the original interior designer, displaying furniture and a photograph taken there by friends after his death. Loans come from his longtime manager Florence Chan, partner Daffy Tong, the fan group Les FANmily and independent artists; many pieces have never been shown publicly.

Six of Cheung’s films will be screened during the exhibition period. Museum staff expect heavy attendance around his birthday on 12 September and will operate a timed-entry queuing system at peak hours.

zh.headline: 文化博物館張國榮70誕辰展今日開幕
zh.dek: 逾300件展品包括罕見舞台服裝及故居場景重現，即日起至2027年5月10日於沙田免費開放。
body: 香港文化博物館星期三起舉辦「繼續寵愛・張國榮70誕辰・紀念展」，展出逾300件來自私人及機構的珍貴展品，紀念已故歌手及演員張國榮的70歲誕辰。
展覽由康樂及文化事務署主辦，展期由2026年9月9日至2027年5月10日，於沙田文化博物館舉行，免費入場。重點展品包括11套經典舞台服裝，當中有1989年「告別演唱會」演唱《為你鍾情》時所穿的斗篷，以及1997年演唱會的金色外套與紫色間條長褲。
博物館首次與原室內設計師合作，重現張國榮故居部分場景，展出其生前使用的傢俬及好友於其身後在故居拍攝的照片。展品由經理人陳淑芬、摯友唐鶴德、歌迷組織Les FANmily及獨立藝術家借出，多件為首次公開展出。
展期內將放映六部張國榮經典電影。館方預料9月12日誕辰當日人流較多，高峰時段將實施排隊定時入場安排。
